findings.change: New isolated agenda-volume regression group and runner registration; documentation/evidence.

temporalContracts.rollingWeek: Server local today inclusive, plus seven local dates exclusive; regular plannedDate only.
temporalContracts.calendarWeek: Sunday server-local calendar week; regular plannedDate only. Active rounds by default, includeInactive and configured recurrence/windows verified.
temporalContracts.adminDay: Europe/Lisbon scheduled day, regular plannedDate fallback to date; extras scheduledAt. Pages of 50.
temporalContracts.adminMonth: Existing server-local month: plannedDate OR date, regular visits only.
temporalContracts.technicianDay: Server-local day; planned schedule/fallback or start/end; cancelled/archived aliases excluded; authenticated technician overrides query technicianId.

integrated.terminalMarker: PASS agenda volume: 25/100/400 pools, 16 technicians, two-year history, exact rolling/calendar/day/month IDs, recurrence, pagination, real UI, permissions, failures and cleanup

initial.stage: Complete initial test draft, before test-only alias/UTC-reporting/screenshot adjustments. Production files identical.

environment.database: Fresh PGlite 0.5.8 per run; socket adapter 0.2.11; schema unchanged.

positiveUtc.scope: Fresh Node process per API profile; RSS includes routers, HTTP client and fixture oracle, excludes DB/browser. Real browser, 1440/390px. Synthetic history does not certify generation or physical devices. Existing temporal contracts are distinct; no calendar-policy change.

gates.readonlyScope: Instrumented API SQL write count zero; real browser sends no API mutation. Eleven model counts and fixture scheduling/status identity unchanged. This does not claim a SQL audit of all browser-triggered server telemetry.

risks: PostgreSQL CI, runner completion, native restore and artifacts remain unconfirmed.
Read-only synthetic history does not certify visit generation, pauses of seasonal services, concurrent calendar writes, production hardware, or uninterrupted two-year operation.
No C10 calendar-policy harmonization: tested separate current meanings and independent fixture eligibility.

Week/month/planner replies and DOM remain proportional to result size. Admin-day and technician pagination still materialize complete eligible lists before slicing. Planner also loads full extra-visit history.
RSS covers a fresh combined API/client/oracle process per profile, not a fresh process per request, and excludes DB/browser. Sampled heap excludes native browser/DOM allocations.
Mobile planner retains existing horizontal table scrolling and long lists; this is volume/navigation evidence, not a redesign or complete mobile-usability audit.
